summary: Viewed all four supplied PNGs, including native 1x and nearest 3x panels on light, dark and checker backgrounds. The large bell silhouette, crown loop, red tassel, dark face and hanging gold clapper read clearly at native size. Broad lighter upper-left patina and darker right planes give the body volume; the gold lip and crown distinguish bronze from the teal surface. No conspicuous accidental transparent holes or severed hand/clapper attachments are visible; the loop opening and space beneath the bell read as intentional. Windup narrows and counterleans the body, move and attack lean right, attack extends the connected lower assembly, recover gathers it inward, hit compresses the crown and dead folds the bell onto its lower edge. Idle changes are small but consistent with clapper/hand sway. This is a floating creature, so grounded feet are not required. The additional states are readable beyond color changes: skill_a gathers turquoise energy around the clapper, skill_b carries two overlapping rightward waves from the extended lower clapper assembly, and skill_c leaves broken light around the bell mouth; poison curls a hand toward the face with bubbles, stun droops the hands under stars, and sleep lowers the body and flattens the facial marks. The status pairs use restrained local changes rather than unrelated attacks. The right outline loses some contrast on the dark background, but the patina and gold rim preserve recognition. This is a still pose preview: timing, hop continuity, actual battle scale, impact alignment and runtime clipping remain unverified. PNG appearance cannot establish the required authoring process. This recommendation is advisory and does not select the candidate for the user.
